justification: Non-admin with empty accessibleNodeIds falls through to `[]` and the length===0 guard at line 280 returns []; only admins get scopeNodeIds=null (unrestricted), which is the intended bypass.
list still returns `{items:[], total:0}` rather than using the deprecated() throw pattern applied to the other procedures.
writeAudit() is called after the role update with action 'member.role_change' and changes payload.
recordSale now checks orgCountryStripeAccounts.chargesEnabled when paymentMethod==='stripe' and throws BAD_REQUEST if absent.
rescheduleInstallment updates installment status to 'pending' and updates nextDueDate but never calls evaluateOverdueLock to recompute the package overdue/lock state.
recordPosSale re-calls validatePromoCode inside the transaction before applying the discount, so deactivated promos are rejected server-side.
pos.recordSale catches a NO_TAX_RATE sentinel thrown by pos.service.ts and remaps it to a BAD_REQUEST; tax rate is no longer silently 0.
Class slot UPDATE now includes `spotsBooked < capacity` predicate and throws CLASS_FULL when affected rows === 0.
listForUser now calls listAppointmentsWithRecurrence and post-filters by userId, so virtual recurrences are included.
appointmentClientId is now fetched and BAD_REQUEST is thrown if missing, but no validation that it belongs to the specified clientId (note explicitly asks for this).
update handler now fetches current spotsBooked and throws BAD_REQUEST if new capacity < spotsBooked.
updateAppointment performs buffer-time conflict checks but does not call any checkTrainerAvailabilityExceptions — grep for that symbol returns 0 matches in appointment.service.ts.
bulkApprove still auto-confirms the first installment with hardcoded paymentMethod 'manual_transfer' without requiring firstInstallmentPaymentMethod in the input.
guardInputBranchForContext now explicitly throws FORBIDDEN when branchId === null (block undefined-vs-null divergence).
createTrainerTier inserts zero-amount commission_tier_rates rows for every active non-conditional category_commission_configs after creating the tier.
createReceipt computes allFull/anyReceived from purchase_order_items.receivedQty and sets PO status to 'received' or 'partially_received'.
runBatch SELECT for commission splits is filtered by `eq(commissionSplits.status, 'approved')`.
upsertCategoryCommissionConfig validates `slotSum === 10000` and throws an error if not.
setBranchPrice input schema accepts effectiveFrom and effectiveUntil but has no .refine() requiring effectiveUntil > effectiveFrom.
createAnnouncement inserts announcements + announcement_scopes but does not insert any notification rows; grep for 'notification' in this service returns 0 matches.
reassignMember checks `!accessibleNodeIds.includes(input.newHierarchyScopeId) && member.role !== 'admin'` and throws FORBIDDEN.
